analysis: Taxonomic TITAN2 and Figure 2; no functional matrices
metadata: All sample IDs, design columns and six predictors match canonical 003b by sample ID.
reference: Original five-axis results plus the previously corrected 003b MHI analysis; not obsolete MHI.
execution_equivalence: All 13 object components and final RNG state identical for native, memory-bounded and interrupted/resumed execution; synthetic and actual 17-profile inputs.
historical_reliability_precision: Raw reliability differs in some taxon-gradient rows, without changing any selection. A five-bootstrap MHI replay matches archived arrays exactly under reference BLAS; OpenBLAS changes permutation ties. See the numerical-precision guide and external audit.
global_rng: All six fits match expected final states in the continuous historical seed-123 stream.
depth_rng: Seeds 124-141 are assigned by fixed depth/gradient position.
figure: Six gradients; each shows global and three depth estimates. Zero-indicator thresholds are suppressed.
limitations: Exploratory univariate associations; no joint locality/predictor adjustment.
Purity/reliability filtering is not across-taxon/gradient FDR control.
Depth contrasts are descriptive, not formal tests.
Intervals are central 80% and 90% bootstrap ranges.
repository_scope: Code and documentation only; no matrices, fitted objects, result tables, images or decorative assets.
